coverage: Read complete supplied check records and relevant native PCB, schematic, footprint and project-rule definitions.
Independently reproduced DRC: 142 violations, 114 parity entries and zero unconnected items; all 13 error entries are saved exclusions.
Independently exported the complete 10-instance schematic hierarchy. All 659 unique schematic pin-to-net assignments match saved PCB pads.

Inspected saved copper, connector drill classification, selected power/return routing and CAN2 resistor population. Recorded commands, versions, calculations and outcomes in review-work/physical/experiments/REVIEW_NOTES.md.

findings.condition: Five unnumbered J1 holes are defined as plated through holes with copper diameter equal to drill diameter.

evidence.locator: Lines 21686–21725: five unnumbered thru_hole pads, including UUID e186b75f-4739-4f2e-a723-906e090de7da; diameter/drill pairs are 4/4 mm or 2.2/2.2 mm.
board.design_settings.rules.min_via_annular_width = 0.1; corresponding padstack and annular_width exclusions have empty comments.
violations[132] through violations[141]: five padstack and five annular-width errors, all excluded:true.
Plated file header; T10C2.200 and T12C4.000; corresponding hits at X75.55, X199.65, X71.95, X120.0 and X203.25.

findings.mechanism: The nominal annular ring is (pad diameter − drill diameter)/2 = 0 mm, below the saved 0.1 mm constraint. Native drill export classifies these holes as plated.
findings.reasoning: This is a reproducible manufacturing-geometry violation, explicitly excluded in the project. Exclusion does not change the copper or drill classification. These holes carry no net; the evidence does not establish an electrical open, mechanical failure or fabricator rejection.
findings.title: Five plated connector holes have zero annular copper

findings.condition: The saved F.Cu fill connects C15.2, U7.4 and C14.2 to the ground zone with one resolved thermal spoke each.

evidence.locator: Ground zone UUID bc540b8b-3ffa-4b00-b211-3a91191a1f6d, line 69477; affected pad UUIDs at lines 13481, 20557 and 28773.
violations[94], [95], [96]: minimum spoke count 2, actual 1; all excluded:true.
Three independently reproduced starved_thermal entries for C15.2, U7.4 and C14.2.

findings.mechanism: Saved copper falls short of the configured two-spoke thermal-relief rule.
findings.reasoning: Both native DRC runs identify the same saved-fill violations. They are explicit saved exclusions with empty comments. Zero unconnected items does not establish compliance with the spoke-count rule. No open circuit, excessive temperature or inadequate ampacity is demonstrated.
findings.title: Three ground thermals fall below the saved spoke-count rule

findings.condition: R36 and R37 are both DNP in the schematic and saved PCB while the two wideband transceivers share CAN2 with the brain-module interface and harness connector.

evidence.locator: Symbol UUID d69380f9-5487-4782-9ce9-0690df62e543, line 2662 onward: 120-ohm resistor, dnp yes, in_bom no; instance references R36 and R37.
R36 and R37 footprints near lines 14746 and 18669: DNP population and pads on /CAN2+ and /CAN2-.
components.R36, components.R37 and nets./CAN2+, nets./CAN2-: U20/U21, J2.73/.74 and J1.15/.11 share the bus.
can_termination: default carrier resistor conductance 0 S; hypothetical single/dual resistor populations give 120/60 ohms.

findings.location: CAN2 bus; R36, R37, U20, U21 and J2
findings.mechanism: Neither carrier termination resistor contributes a resistive load with the saved population. Any completed-bus termination must therefore come from another assembly element.
findings.reasoning: The carrier population is established, but brain-module termination and external harness configuration were not established. ERC, connectivity and geometry checks do not measure assembled-bus termination or signaling. This is a configuration concern, not proof that the short internal CAN bus fails.
findings.title: CAN2 termination depends on unverified module or harness configuration

limitations: Saved copper only; no refill pass or comparison against newly generated zone fill.
No physical electrical, CAN waveform or temperature measurements. No CAN bit-rate, cable or edge-rate model was evaluated.
No ampacity or thermal qualification. Conditional heater-trace resistance calculations exclude contacts, barrels, actual operating temperature and full supply/return-loop impedance.
No complete module-internal review, including brain CAN termination or integrated FOME-MC coverage; the separate original as-received checkout was not reviewed.
No exhaustive 3D assembly-clearance, fabrication-tolerance, solder-process or manufacturer-drawing validation. Primary connector drawing retrieval failed DNS resolution.
Disabled courtyard checks and the saved zero copper-edge minimum do not establish manufacturing clearance acceptance.
Not every ERC, library or parity warning was individually adjudicated against component datasheets.
Automotive transients, ignition energy, wideband stability, EMC and manufacturing approval remain outside this review.
